title: Huntress: rogue ScreenConnect clients pushed to hundreds of hosts in SCKit attacks; ConnectWise disables extensions
what_changed: Summary, plain text and key finding no longer say SCKit uses CVE-2026-84869 against technicians. Huntress's report says the toolkit tries to steal the technician's session cookie (.aspxauth) and replay it against the panel, and names the CVE only as background; the step has not been seen to succeed.
